proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost { kind: "action" }
proposed_widenings.justification: Nature's Sanctuary is activated with a Magic action, which is a standard action kind. ClassFeatureActivationCost only has `free` and `bonus_action`. Action-cost class features are a common pattern (compare Channel Divinity, Wild Shape itself) and require a new variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape...

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader.duration (timed with condition expiry)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature creates a persistent zone that lasts 1 minute or until a condition (Incapacitated) or death. ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader has no duration field at all — it models only instantaneous activations. A timed class feature zone requires a duration shape analogous to spell Duration, extended with condition-based expiry triggers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die.

proposed_widenings.name: multi_activation class feature (primary + secondary repositioning activation)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature has two distinct activation clauses: (1) the primary Magic action that creates the area, and (2) a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to reposition the Cube. The current activation family supports exactly one activation cost and one effect — no secondary activation subgraph exists.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.

proposed_widenings.name: UseCountResource: cross-feature resource reference (consumes Wild Shape use)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature does not have its own use-count pool; it consumes a use from Wild Shape, which is a separate class feature with its own resource. The surface has no mechanism to express consumption of another feature's `use_count` pool. A cross-feature resource reference variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...you can expend a use of your Wild Shape...

proposed_widenings.name: grant_cover (Half Cover to area occupants)
proposed_widenings.justification: The zone grants Half Cover (+2 AC, +2 DEX saves) to creatures within it. v4 has `modify_ac` as a reaction effect atom, but no `grant_cover` atom expressing a persistent zone-conditional AC/save modifier keyed to area occupancy. Half Cover is a distinct SRD mechanic from a flat AC delta.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area...

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: grant_resistance_from_feature (cross-feature state projection)
proposed_widenings.justification: The zone propagates the *current* Resistance type granted by Nature's Ward (a separate L10 class feature) to allies in the area. This requires projecting runtime state from another feature into the effect. v4 has `grant_resistance` but no mechanism for a resistance whose type is resolved at runtime from another feature's live state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there.

notes: All six gaps are independently blocking. The structural gaps (no duration on class features, no multi-activation family, no cross-feature resource reference, no cross-feature state projection) prevent honest encoding in any existing family. The unit is a persistent mobile zone with two simultaneous conditional effects — a shape the surface has no vocabulary for. Do not attempt to force into `activation` family; the trace would be fundamentally false.
